description:
Create an order ONLY AFTER preview_print_order, image display and buyer confirmation.

    First present every preview image (or the viewer fallback), dimensions, material/color,
    quantity and quote. Obtain explicit buyer confirmation for that preview version.
    Then send preview_id, preview_version, buyer_confirmed=true, job_name and shipping
    details ONLY; omit model/options fields. Any relevant change needs a new preview.
    Legacy model inputs without a preview return a preview and NEVER create an order.

    Set geometry, material, color, quantities and operator notes in preview_print_order.
    OpenSCAD is preferred for designs made in conversation; uploaded STL and cached
    model IDs are also supported there. One preview covers the whole multi-part order.
    Confirm the shipping address with the buyer. ship_to requires their full name and
    US address; contact_email is used for updates. This returns a job ID and total,
    plus a payment link when payment is required. The buyer pays in their own browser.

model_id.description: Reusable id from validate_stl; valid for 24 hours.
model_id.title: Model Id

name.description: Short part name, shown on the card and receipt.
name.title: Name

openscad_source.description: OpenSCAD in millimeters; give exactly one model source.
openscad_source.title: Openscad Source

quantity.description: Copies of THIS part. Capped by how long this part takes to print, not a flat number -- checked once its geometry is known; a rejected order reports the real cap for this part's size.
quantity.title: Quantity

stl_base64.description: STL in millimeters; give exactly one model source.
stl_base64.title: Stl Base64

buyer_confirmed.description: True ONLY after showing every preview image/options/price and receiving explicit buyer confirmation. Not proof of human viewing.
buyer_confirmed.title: Buyer Confirmed

color.description: Filament color, e.g. black or white.
color.title: Color

contact_email.description: The buyer's email, for the receipt and order updates.
contact_email.title: Contact Email

job_name.description: A short name for the item, shown on the order and the receipt, e.g. "Desk cable clip".
job_name.title: Job Name

notes.description: Optional notes for the operator, e.g. which face should look best.
notes.title: Notes

openscad_source.description: OpenSCAD source for the model, in millimeters; rendered on our server. Preferred for models designed in the conversation. Give this or stl_base64, not both.
openscad_source.title: Openscad Source

parts.description: The WHOLE order, one entry per part. Use a model_id from earlier validation, an STL, or OpenSCAD. Each entry has its own name, material, color and quantity. Each part's quantity is capped by its own print time, not a flat count. Shipping and handling are charged once; never add independent quote totals.
parts.title: Parts

preview_id.description: The id returned by preview_print_order for the images shown to the buyer.
preview_id.title: Preview Id

preview_version.description: The exact preview version the buyer confirmed; changes require a new preview.
preview_version.title: Preview Version

quantity.description: How many identical copies. Capped by print time, not a flat number; the totals cover all of them.
quantity.title: Quantity

ship_to.description: Required. Recipient's full name and US street address, including city, state and ZIP. We ship within the United States only.
ship_to.title: Ship To

stl_base64.description: The model as a base64-encoded STL file, in millimeters. Give this or openscad_source, not both.
stl_base64.title: Stl Base64

name: submit_print_job
title: Order a 3D print
